stages.blurb: Pictures and video come from a nearby CDN. Likes, posts, and feed refresh go through an API.
Reading the feed and creating a post are two services. First, the system checks who you are.
Who you follow, a ranker, and a saved copy of the feed make scrolling feel instant.
People, post text, and photo files live in different stores on purpose.
Posting does not wait until every follower’s feed is updated. That work runs in the background.
Notifications and search are extra paths—not the same request as “create post.”
